description:
Goal

A curried direct call carries the exact producer-owned argument and capture contract into native lowering, so the checked-in curried_add behavior agrees across interp, JIT, and AOT without native codegen reconstructing or compensating for missing lanes.

Signal

On unchanged integration HEAD 2de30c10c, release curried_add passes interp but run fails before codegen: `native direct call emitted 2 arguments ... target ... declares 3`. The fz-9i4.4.4 deletion worktree fails identically. That ticket only removes permanently absent closure direct_target fields; the failing direct-call argument construction is an untouched upstream path.

Strategy

Use the semantic compiler root-cause loop before implementation. Trace the exact callable construction, transport shape, runtime demand, direct-call summary, and NativeProgram arguments backward to the first authority that loses or misclassifies the capture/argument boundary. Preserve/refine that producer-owned structure forward. Do not pad arguments in codegen, decode identities, add a per-FnId registry, or select among reconstructed physical surfaces.

Plan

1. Pin curried_add interp/native divergence and dump raw authoritative products at each boundary using borrowed telemetry.
2. Prove the first mismatching producer with a minimal spike and compare captured, zero-capture, and non-curried controls.
3. Update this ticket with the proven correction and exact test plan before production implementation.
4. Implement test-first at the first data-model loss, deleting obsolete compensations or duplicate surface calculations.
5. Verify curried_add and controls through interp/JIT/AOT, then full library, formatting, strict clippy, and docs.

Acceptance

curried_add matches its oracle through interp, run, and build. Structural tests prove native direct-call arguments and the callee contract refine the same producer-owned callable construction; no downstream padding, registry, identity reconstruction, or fallback is added. Captured, zero-capture, and ordinary direct-call controls remain green; full gates pass warning-free.
title: Preserve curried direct-call argument contract
